## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen?

## Scope

Which part of the system does this touch (`schema`, `core`, `adapters`, `sdk`, a
surface)? Larger or cross-cutting ideas may warrant an RFC — see
[`docs/rfcs`](../../docs/rfcs).

## Alternatives

Any alternative approaches you've considered.
